captions.youtube_title: Stream Gear Bought Dec 31: Does It Count for 2026?
captions.youtube_description: You begin to depreciate business property when it is placed in service: ready and available for a specific use, not when you buy it. Source: IRS Publication 946. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games. General information, not advice for your situation.

sources.fact: Depreciation begins when property is placed in service = ready and available for a specific use

thumb.title: Bought *Dec 31?*
thumb.sub: It has to be set up.

voice: Buying stream gear for GTA VI before December 31st? Buying it isn't enough. Ordered December 30th, arrives in January? That's 2027. Still in the box? Not yet. For 2026, it has to be set up and ready to stream by December 31st. Keep the receipt, and only the business share counts. Link in bio.
